---
title: "Simulation Example: MINQUE0 vs IMINQUE"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Simulation Minque}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
---

```{r}
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(KernelNN)   # your package
n<-1000
p<-500
it<-100
pvalue_mnq0<-matrix(NA, nrow = it, ncol = 4)
est_mq0<-matrix(NA, nrow = it, ncol = 3)
pvalue_imnq<-matrix(NA, nrow = it, ncol = 4)
est_imq<-matrix(NA, nrow = it, ncol = 3)

for (i in 1:it)
{
  G2<-matrix(rbinom(n*p,1,0.02), nrow = n, ncol = p)
  G2<-scale(G2)
  G1<-matrix(rnorm(n*p), nrow = n, ncol = p)
  I<-diag(n)
  # K2<-K1^2

  y<-mvrnorm(n = 1, mu = rep(0,n), Sigma =2*I)
  KernelList<-KernelGenerator(DataMatrix = list(G1,G2), kernelName = "product")

  HiddenKernel <- Linear(KernelList)
  vcs.result_minque0<-MINQUE0(KList = HiddenKernel,y = y)
  mnq0_test<-MNQTest0_Chi(KList = HiddenKernel,vcs = vcs.result_minque0$vcs,ComponentID = c(1,2),y = y)
  vcs.result_iminque<-IMINQUE(KList = HiddenKernel,y = y,prior = rep(1,length(HiddenKernel)),epoch=100,threshold = 1e-3)
  # if ("err" %in% names(vcs.result))
  # {
  #   next
  # }
  mnq1_test<-IMNQTest_Normal(KList = HiddenKernel, vcs  = vcs.result_iminque$vcs,ComponentID=c(1,2))

  # if ("err" %in% names(zTest))
  # {
  #   next;
  # }
  est_mq0[i,]<-vcs.result_minque0$vcs
  est_imq[i,]<-vcs.result_iminque$vcs
  pvalue_mnq0[i,1:(length(HiddenKernel)-1)]<-mnq0_test$components[1:(length(HiddenKernel)-1)]
  pvalue_mnq0[i,3]<-mnq0_test$overall
  pvalue_mnq0[i,4]<-1

  pvalue_imnq[i,1:(length(HiddenKernel)-1)]<-mnq1_test$components[1:(length(HiddenKernel)-1)]
  pvalue_imnq[i,3]<-mnq1_test$overall
  pvalue_imnq[i,4]<-1
}
pvalue_mnq0<-as.data.frame(pvalue_mnq0)
pvalue_imnq<-as.data.frame(pvalue_imnq)
est_mq0<-as.data.frame(est_mq0)
est_imq<-as.data.frame(est_imq)
colnames(pvalue_mnq0)<-c("par1","par2","Overall","IT")
colnames(pvalue_imnq)<-c("par1","par2","Overall","IT")
colnames(est_mq0)<-c("par1","par2","Overall")
colnames(est_imq)<-c("par1","par2","Overall")

est_mq0$Method<-"MINQUE0"
est_imq$Method<-"IMINQUE"
est<-rbind(est_imq,est_mq0)




xseq<-seq(0,1,by = 0.001)
Power_mnq0<-matrix(nrow = length(xseq),ncol = 3)
colnames(Power_mnq0)<-c("par1","par2","Overall")
Power_imnq<-matrix(nrow = length(xseq),ncol = 3)
colnames(Power_imnq)<-c("par1","par2","Overall")
for(i in seq_along(xseq))
{
  Power_mnq0[i,]<-colMeans(pvalue_mnq0[,c("par1","par2","Overall")]<xseq[i])
  Power_imnq[i,]<-colMeans(pvalue_imnq[,c("par1","par2","Overall")]<xseq[i])
}
Power_mnq0<-as.data.frame(Power_mnq0)
Power_imnq<-as.data.frame(Power_imnq)
Power_mnq0$xseq<-xseq
Power_imnq$xseq<-xseq
Power_mnq0$Method<-"MINQUE0"
Power_imnq$Method<-"IMINQUE"
Power<-rbind(Power_mnq0,Power_imnq)
Power[which(Power$xseq==0.05),]


Data <- melt(
  Power,
  id.vars = c("Method", "xseq"),        # keep these columns
  measure.vars = c("par1", "par2", "Overall"),   # reshape these
  variable.name = "Parameter",
  value.name = "Value"
)


est_long <- melt(
  est,
  id.vars = "Method",
  measure.vars = c("par1", "par2", "Overall"),
  variable.name = "Parameter",
  value.name = "Value"
)


TypeIError<-ggplot(Data)+aes(x=xseq, y=Value)+geom_point()+
  facet_grid(Method ~ Parameter)+
  geom_abline(aes(slope=1,intercept=0))+xlim(0,1)+ylim(0,1)+
  ylab("Type I error")+xlab("Significance level")

estPlot<-ggplot(est_long)+ aes(x = Parameter, y = Value)+
  geom_boxplot() +  facet_grid(.~Method)+
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Boxplot of par1, par2, and Overall by Method",
    x = "Parameter",
    y = "Value"
  )

print(TypeIError)
print(estPlot)

```
